name: NVIDIA 设备组合与场景选型工作流
description: 从数据库、API、CSV、Word、PDF 与官方网页构建设备组合评分，生成交互报告、PPT、网页演示、Word 和架构图。

config.sql: SELECT platform, workload, throughput_index, latency_index, energy_efficiency_index, software_readiness, deployment_readiness, scenario_note FROM demo_examples.nvidia_device_benchmarks ORDER BY platform, workload
config.taskName: 读取模拟设备性能基准
获取 NVIDIA 产品组合 API

nodes.name: 关联场景并计算适配评分

config.requirements: 关联设备基准、产品组合、成本情景与工作负载，计算吞吐、延迟、能效、软件成熟度和三年成本的可复核综合分。
config.script: SELECT b.platform, b.workload, p.segment, p.generation, p.form_factor, p.target_workload, c.scenario_id, c.estimated_3y_tco_usd_k, w.business_scenario, w.target_latency_ms, w.data_location, ROUND(b.throughput_index*0.35 + b.latency_index*0.25 + b.energy_efficiency_index*0.20 + b.software_readiness*0.20,2) AS fit_score, b.deployment_readiness, b.scenario_note FROM benchmark b LEFT JOIN portfolio p ON lower(p.platform) LIKE '%' || lower(b.platform) || '%' OR lower(b.platform) LIKE '%' || lower(p.platform) || '%' LEFT JOIN cost c ON c.workload = CASE b.workload WHEN '大模型训练' THEN 'foundation_model_training' WHEN '企业推理' THEN 'enterprise_inference' WHEN '机器人与边缘AI' THEN 'robotics_development' WHEN '可视化与推理' THEN 'visual_computing' ELSE 'local_ai_prototyping' END LEFT JOIN workload w ON w.business_scenario = CASE b.workload WHEN '大模型训练' THEN '超大规模模型训练' WHEN '企业推理' THEN '企业知识助手推理' WHEN '机器人与边缘AI' THEN '机器人视觉决策' WHEN '可视化与推理' THEN '工程设计与数字孪生' ELSE '本地模型原型开发' END ORDER BY fit_score DESC

config.requirements: 按工作负载选择最高分平台并汇总三年成本，保留备选方案和验证事项。
config.script: WITH ranked AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY workload ORDER BY fit_score DESC, estimated_3y_tco_usd_k NULLS LAST) AS choice_rank FROM scored) SELECT workload, platform, segment, generation, target_workload, scenario_id, estimated_3y_tco_usd_k, fit_score, deployment_readiness, CASE WHEN choice_rank=1 THEN '建议组合' ELSE '备选方案' END AS recommendation FROM ranked WHERE choice_rank<=2 ORDER BY workload, choice_rank

nodes.name: AI 设备组合决策分析

config.prompt: 你是企业 AI 基础设施规划负责人。综合上游设备评分、组合摘要、成本与工作负载数据、访谈、路线 PDF 和官方网页，形成中文设备组合决策。明确区分 NVIDIA 官方事实、模拟性能指数、模拟成本和管理判断。逐场景说明首选与备选、三年成本、部署前置条件、软件成熟度、机房功率与冷却、供应和产品代际风险，并给出 PoC 指标、30/60/90 天路线及需要业务确认的假设。不得把模拟指数写成官方参数。
